blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
blocks.zh: Harness自演化修改了代理的软件脚手架,包括提示,内存,工作流程,以及可执行组件,同时保持模型权重固定. 我们正式确定一个反馈驱动的进程,在这一进程中,接受的修订始终存在。 该框架将更新目标与建议和接纳机制分开。 它区分了对解释状态的修改和对工具和代码的修订,寄存器级控制逻辑,以及插件构成. 我们通过进化优化来描述搜索的特点,并通过持续的PAC学习来检查其可靠性. 在明确的假设下,分析产生一个预期的概括约束,以历史回归预算为条件的保留约束,以及使用新的独立验证数据的高概率的承认规则。 我们审查持续利用的修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流程,对科学可靠性、人身安全和机构问责制产生影响。 以往工作的案例说明了模型-harness协同设计、分布式执行和插件再利用。 可靠的部署需要随着任务分配和评价人员的改变而不断加以验证,同时对学习、运行时间特权和相应的行动提供独立的保障。 我们在https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI网站上,全面讨论了66页的有关工作、理论、算法、评价、应用以及Harness RSI的更广泛影响。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As tasks and environments change after deployment, agents need mechanisms for continued adaptation. Harness self-evolution uses execution feedback to revise instructions, memory, and control logic while keeping model weights fixed. Later runs load accepted revisions, and the update mechanism remains available to learn from subsequent experience (Section 2 ). This process builds on recursive self-improvement and self-referential problem solving in the context of contemporary agents ( good1965ultraintelligent ; schmidhuber2003godel ) .
blocks.zh: 随着任务和环境在部署后发生变化,代理人需要不断适应的机制。 机理自演化利用执行反馈来修改指令,内存,和控制逻辑,同时保持模型权重固定. 后来运行了经接受的加载修订,更新机制仍然可用以学习随后的经验(第2节)。 这一过程建立在当代代理商(良好1965年的Ultrainintgent;schmidhuber2003godel)背景下的递归自我改进和自我优惠问题的解决之上。

blocks.en: Adaptation can revise model weights or the harness governing prompts, memory, workflows, and tools. Our focus on the latter rests on three considerations. First, the harness directly shapes a fixed model’s behavior, while reusable procedures preserve task constraints and lessons from earlier failures ( chan2025mlebench ; zhao2024expel ; wang2024voyager ) . Second, harness revisions reuse an existing model deployment, avoiding retraining and additional weight checkpoints. This can reduce adaptation and maintenance costs and permits updates through proprietary APIs without access to model weights. Third, instructions, memory records, and code support direct inspection, version comparison, and change tracking; attributing behavioral differences between model checkpoints can require additional controlled experiments. We hold the task model fixed to isolate harness self-evolution, with joint model–harness evolution addressed in Section .
blocks.zh: 适应可以修改模型权重或制约提示、内存、工作流程和工具的利用。 我们注重后者有三个考虑。 首先,这种牵引装置直接塑造了固定模型的行为,而可重复使用的程序则保留了任务限制和早期失败的教训(chan2025mlebench;zhao2024expel;wang2024voyager). 第二,利用修订重新使用现有的模式部署,避免再培训和增加重量检查站。 这可以降低适应和维护成本,并允许通过专有API进行更新而无法获得模型权重. 第三,指令、内存记录和代码支持直接检查、版本比较和变化跟踪;将模型检查站之间的行为差异归结为需要更多的控制实验。 我们把任务模式固定在隔离利用自我进化的状态上,

blocks.en: Existing methods vary in what is modified, how candidates are generated, and how revisions are admitted ( shinn2023reflexion ; zhao2024expel ; wang2024voyager ; zhang2025aflow ; robeyns2025selfimproving ) . We first classify the update target : the state modified and inherited by later runs. Interpreted-state updates revise instructions, stored experience, or task-level coordination over predefined capabilities; executable revisions change capability implementations, runtime control logic, or plugin-based service composition (Section 3 ; Figure 1 ). Empirical selection alone does not establish generalization or retention. Section relates candidate search to evolutionary structures, then uses stability and concentration results to state conditions for expected generalization, bounded accumulated regressions, and high-probability admission. Persistent state also determines how revisions propagate and which consequences software recovery can address, motivating system design choices, continual validation, and independent safety controls (Sections – ).
blocks.zh: 现有方法在修改内容,考生产生方式,以及录取方式(shinn2023reflexion ;zhao2024expel ;wang2024voyager ;zhang2025aflow ;长袍2025selfimage )方面各不相同. 我们首先对更新目标进行分类:状态由后期运行修改和继承. 解译状态更新修改指令,存储经验,或任务级别协调相对于预定义能力;可执行修改修改能力执行,运行时间控制逻辑,或基于插件的服务构成(第3节;图1). 仅凭经验选择并不能确立概括或保留。 该科将候选人搜索与进化结构联系起来,然后利用稳定性和集中性结果来说明预期的概括性条件、累积的回归和高概率的承认。 持续状态还决定了修改如何推广,以及软件回收可产生何种后果,激励系统设计选择,持续验证,以及独立的安全控制(sections — — ).

blocks.en: This work makes three contributions: • Definition and Operational Taxonomy (Sections 2 – 3 ). We define a persistent feedback-driven lifecycle and organize interpreted-state updates and executable revisions by their mutation boundaries. • Conditional Theoretical Analysis (Section ). We map harness search to evolutionary structures and derive conditions for expected generalization, bounded accumulated regressions, and high-probability admission from classical stability and concentration results. • Systems Implications and Design Trade-offs (Sections – ). We analyze propagation and repair burdens in five settings and connect attributed cases (Sections 3 and ) to model–harness pairing, deployment, and reuse decisions, with continual validation and safety constraints.
blocks.zh: 这项工作作出三项贡献:定义和业务分类(第2-3节)。 我们定义了持续的反馈驱动生命周期,并按其突变边界组织解释状态更新和可执行修订. • 有条件的理论分析(第......节)。 我们把搜索图绘制到进化结构中,为预期的概括、累积的回归和从古典稳定和集中结果中高概率的承认提供条件。 • 系统影响和设计权衡(各节) 我们分析五种环境下的传播和修复负担,并将被归结的病例(第3节和)与模型的配对、部署和再利用决定联系起来,同时不断进行验证和安全限制。

blocks.en: 2 Definition of Harness Self-Evolution
blocks.zh: 2 合理性自我演变的定义

blocks.en: Following the model–harness decomposition ( deepseek2026harness ) , we define a harness H H as the software and configuration governing a model M M ’s execution in a task environment E E . Table 1 summarizes seven runtime functions. Model adapters are part of H H ; learned parameters are part of M M . Execution produces a rollout, which is scored by J J : τ ∼ Run ⁡ ( M , H , E ) , y = J ⁡ ( τ ) . \tau\sim\operatorname{Run}(M,H,E),\qquad y=J(\tau). (1) The final assessment J J includes scoring, outcome verification, and the records that determine the result. Candidates may revise internal critics or provisional checks within H H , but cannot modify J J .

blocks.zh: 表1:牵引装置的运行时间功能。 一项实施可以合并这些功能,而不是将每个功能分配给一个单独的模块。

blocks.en: Harness self-evolution uses execution experience to iteratively revise H H , aiming to improve task performance or resource efficiency while holding M M fixed. At round k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 , the incumbent H k − 1 H_{k-1} generates a batch of b b rollouts, each including its trajectory, outcome, and available feedback: ℬ k \displaystyle\mathcal{B}_{k} = { τ k , i } i = 1 b , τ k , i ∼ Run ⁡ ( M , H k − 1 , E k , i ) , \displaystyle=\{\tau_{k,i}\}_{i=1}^{b},\qquad\tau_{k,i}\sim\operatorname{Run}(M,H_{k-1},E_{k,i}), (2) H k \displaystyle H_{k} = Update ⁡ ( H k − 1 , ℬ k ) . \displaystyle=\operatorname{Update}(H_{k-1},\mathcal{B}_{k}). (3) The update operator combines diagnosis, proposal, assessment, and admission. It may draw on historical feedback, archived candidates, and additional validation rollouts. If no revision is admitted, the incumbent is retained: H k = H k − 1 H_{k}=H_{k-1} .

Each retained revision changes the state used for subsequent execution, whose feedback can guide the next update. This lifecycle requires: 1. Operational feedback and update continuity. The system uses feedback from its own executions to construct or select revisions algorithmically, and retains the mechanism for further updates. Environments, automated assessors, and people may provide feedback; admission may require human approval. 2. Persistence across runs. Accepted revisions are stored and loaded in a subsequent run, allowing experience from one interaction to influence later execution. These requirements concern repeatability: one observed update can demonstrate the capability if both hold. Appending logs or compacting context under fixed rules does not revise the harness; learning reusable procedures or changing memory policies can. Revising the update mechanism adds another level of recursion.
blocks.zh: 每个保留版本都会改变用于后续执行的状态,其反馈可以指导下一次更新. 这一生命周期要求: 1. 业务反馈和更新连续性。 该系统使用自身处决的反馈来构建或按算法选择修订,并保留进一步更新的机制. 环境、自动评估员和人员可以提供反馈;接纳可能需要人类批准。 2. 持久性贯穿全局。 接受的修订被存储并加载在后续运行中,允许从一次互动中的经验影响以后的执行. 这些要求涉及可重复性:一项观察到的更新可以证明,如果两者都维持的话。 在固定规则下附加日志或紧凑的上下文不会修改控制;学习可重复使用的程序或改变内存政策可以. 修改更新机制增加了另一个层次的重复.

blocks.en: Self-evolution denotes the update process; self-improvement denotes a gain established by comparison. We use harness RSI (recursive self-improvement) as the name of the research area, without assuming that each revision helps. Weight-only adaptation and scaffolds without an update mechanism fall outside this scope. When a system also trains weights, we examine its harness updates with the task model held fixed.
blocks.zh: 自演化表示更新过程;自修表示通过比较确定的增益. 我们使用“RSI”(重复自我改进)作为研究区的名称,而不假定每次修订都有帮助。 没有更新机制的重力专用适应和脚手架不属于这个范围. 当一个系统也训练重量时, 我们用固定的任务模型来检查它的利用率更新。

blocks.en: 3 The Taxonomy of Harness Self-Evolution
blocks.zh: 3 利用自我演变的分类

blocks.en: EURISKO’s heuristic revision and the Gödel Machine’s proof-governed self-rewriting established distinct antecedents of harness self-evolution ( lenat1983eurisko ; schmidhuber2003godel ) . Contemporary methods use empirical feedback to revise prompts, consolidate persistent memory, and search workflow specifications around a fixed model ( agrawal2026gepa ; fernando2024promptbreeder ; zhao2024expel ; wang2025workflow ; zhang2025aflow ) . The interpreted/executable distinction concerns the edited artifact’s role, not its programming language. Workflow revisions remain interpreted when they change task-level sequencing or routing through fixed coordination interfaces over predefined operators. This includes code that only composes those operators; revising operator implementations or the runtime mechanisms that enact coordination constitutes an executable revision, even under an unchanged executor.
blocks.zh: EURISKO的高压修正和Gödel机器的证明式自我重写建立了独特的自演化前先例(lenat1983eurisko;schmidhuber2003godel). 当代方法使用经验反馈来修改提示,巩固持久性内存,并围绕固定模型(agranwal2026gepa;fernando2024promptbreeder;zhao2024expel;wang2025workflow;zhang2025aflow)搜索工作流程规范. 被解释/可执行的区别涉及编辑文物的作用,而不是其编程语言。 工作流程修改在通过固定协调接口改变任务级别排序或路径时,仍然会比预定义的操作员进行解释. 这包括只构成这些运算符的代码;修订运算符执行或发布协调的运行时间机制构成可执行的修订,即使在一个不变的执行器下也是如此.

blocks.en: We organize executable targets into component implementations, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. The first two describe mutation scope; the third describes how components and runtime services are bound and replaced. Plugin composition can span component implementations and repository-level logic, so a revision may belong to more than one category. Classifying the update target does not determine whether a method satisfies the feedback, continuity, and persistence requirements in Section 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们将可执行目标组织为组件执行,寄存器级控制逻辑和插件组成. 前两个描述突变范围;第三个描述组件和运行时服务如何捆绑和替换. 插件构成可以跨越组件执行和寄存层逻辑,因此修订可能属于多个类别. 对更新目标进行分类并不能确定某一方法是否符合第2节中的反馈、连续性和持久性要求。

blocks.en: 3.1 Tools and Code Patches
blocks.zh: 3.1 工具和代码补丁

blocks.en: Component-level revision confines mutation to callable procedures or designated modules while keeping surrounding orchestration outside the editable surface. Where entry points and I/O contracts remain fixed, candidates replace component implementations; tool synthesis may instead extend the callable interface. Skill libraries retain executable functions for later retrieval and composition ( wang2024voyager ; yu2025polyskill ) ; patch-based architectures, including Self-Harness, HarnessCompass, and Agentic Harness Engineering, constrain trace-guided mutation to selected components ( zhang2026selfharness ; zhang2026harnesscompass ; lin2026agentic ) . Editing memory-management functions changes the harness machinery, whereas curating stored entries changes its interpreted state ( zhang2025memevolve ) . Within this boundary, candidate archives preserve alternatives for subsequent search ( luo2026harnessbank ) , while protocol perturbations test whether an evolved harness’s gain over the initial harness survives changes in assessment conditions ( zhu2026badgenius ) . Stable interfaces facilitate replacement and local checks, but changed outputs or shared state can propagate regressions beyond the edited module.
blocks.zh: 组件级修订仅限于可调用的程序或指定模块,同时将环绕在可编辑表面之外。 如果切入点和I/O合同保持不变,候选人将取代组件执行;工具综合则可能扩大可调用的接口。 技能库保留可执行功能,用于以后的检索和组成(wang2024voyager;yu2025polyskill ) ;基于补丁的架构,包括Self-Harness,HarnessCompass,以及Agentic Harness工程,将微量导突变限制在选定的组件(zhang2026selfharness;zhang2026harnesscompass;lin2026agentic ). 编辑内存管理功能会改变带状机械,而管理存储条目会改变其解释状态(zhang2025memevolve ). 在此界限内,候选档案保存可供后续搜索(luo2026harnessbank ) 的替代品,而协议扰动则测试一个进化的绳索是否在评估条件(zhu2026badgenius ) 的变化中存活下来。 稳定的界面有利于替换和本地检查,但更改的输出或共享状态可以传播到编辑模块之外的回归.

blocks.en: 3.2 Repository and Runtime Logic
blocks.zh: 3.2 仓库和运行时逻辑

blocks.en: Repository-level search exposes context construction, orchestration loops, execution hooks, recovery, and termination to revision. The boundary concerns control over interactions among harness components, rather than the number of files edited. Whole-agent synthesis searches complete control programs, while repository evolution retains implementation lineages for later selection and revision ( hu2025automated ; lee2026metaharness ; robeyns2025selfimproving ; zhang2026darwin ; zhang2026darwinx ; wang2025huxley ) . Changes to shared context, scheduling, or recovery can alter the inputs and execution assumptions of otherwise unchanged components. This coupling motivates edit constraints, transfer-oriented admission, and deployment checks ( xia2026rrsi ; cai2026moss ) . Archive membership preserves a candidate for further search; adoption additionally requires promoting the selected program into the runtime used by later tasks. Extending mutation to the optimizer’s prompts, hooks, and tools makes the update mechanism itself evolvable ( wang2026verse ) . An exported program satisfies the continuing lifecycle only if its deployment retains an update mechanism.
blocks.zh: 仓库级搜索曝光上下文构建,管弦乐圈,执行钩,恢复,终止修改. 边界涉及控制带状组件之间的相互作用,而不是控制编辑的文件数量。 全剂合成搜索完整控制程序,而寄存器进化则保留执行线条供以后选择和修改(hu2025自动;lee2026metaharness;tapyns2025selfimage ;zhang2026darwin;zhang2026darwinx;wang2025huxley). 对共享上下文、时间安排或恢复的修改可以改变原未改变的组件的投入和执行假设。 这种组合激发了编辑约束,转录导向,以及部署检查(xia2026rrsi;cai2026ss). 归档成员保存一个候选人供进一步搜索;通过还需要将选定的程序推广到以后的任务所使用的运行时间。 将突变扩展至优化器的提示、钩子和工具,使更新机制本身可以变换(wang2026verse) 。 输出程序只有在其部署保留更新机制的情况下,才能满足持续生命周期。

blocks.en: HarnessOpt extends the SkillOpt-Lite study from skill editing to runtime revision, improving spreadsheet previews, output checks, and recovery after tool failures ( shen2026skilloptlite ) . On SpreadsheetBench (Table 2 ), GPT-5.4-nano with HarnessOpt and skill reaches 77.58%, exceeding GPT-5.5 with SkillOpt (76.20%); across all four models, HarnessOpt with skill improves on SkillOpt-Lite by 5.69–11.39 percentage points. This crossover illustrates model–harness pairing, but does not establish superiority at matched cost.
blocks.zh: 调和 Opt将SkillOpt-Lite研究从技能编辑扩展至运行时间修订,改进电子表格预览,输出检查,以及工具故障后恢复(Shen2026skilloptlite ). 在电子表格Bench(表2)上,带有HarnessOpt和技能的GPT-5.4-nano达到77.58%,与SkillOpt(76.20%)相比超过GPT-5.5;在所有四个模型中,具有技能的HarnessOpt-Lite提高了5.69-11.39个百分点。 这种交叉现象说明了模型的缺陷配对,但没有以相应的成本确定优越性。

blocks.zh: 表2:电子表格Bench精度(%),从Shen2026skilloptlite表3中的比例换算而来。 HO: HarnessOpt; + 技能:有技能条件.

blocks.en: 3.3 Everything Is a Plugin
blocks.zh: 3.3 所有东西都是插件

blocks.en: Plugin architectures organize mutation through declared interfaces, dependency constraints, and lifecycle operations. The editable object may be a component implementation or a binding that determines which implementation supplies a runtime service, such as memory storage, tool dispatch, or the agent loop. Composition here therefore reaches beyond task-level routing among fixed operators. Kernel-defined substrates specify how these services are connected, mounted, and replaced ( deepseek2026harness ; shi2026programming ) ; feedback-driven systems revise typed primitives, versioned resources, or scoped modules under interface and validation constraints ( chen2026harnessx ; li2026argus ; zhang2026autogenesis ; wu2026modularrsi ) . This organization can expose both local capabilities and core runtime services while retaining explicit constraints on their composition. Everything Is a Plugin (EIP) extends it to capabilities generated, validated, and mounted during operation. Interface contracts support compatibility checks and component replacement; they do not establish behavioral isolation or safe admission. Adoption still requires validation of the composed behavior.
blocks.zh: 插件架构通过宣布的接口,依赖约束,以及生命周期操作组织突变. 可编辑对象可以是组件执行或绑定,确定哪些执行提供运行时间服务,如内存存储,工具发送,或代理循环. 因此,这里的构成超出了固定运营商的任务范围。 Kernel定义的下限指定了这些服务的连接,挂载和替换方式(deepseek2026harness ; shi2026programming ; 反馈驱动的系统在接口和验证限制下修改打字原型,版本资源,或范围化模块(chen2026harnessx; li2026argus; zhang2026autegency; wu2026modularrsi). 该组织既可以暴露当地的能力,也可以暴露核心运行时间服务,同时保留对其构成的明确限制。 万物是一个插件(EIP),将其延伸至运行期间生成,验证和挂载的能力. 界面合同支持兼容性检查和组件替换;它们不建立行为隔离或安全录用. 收养仍需验证构成的行为。

blocks.en: Using DSH Everything, a Codex plugin lets the agent generate tools during execution and retain them for later tasks ( shen2026dsheverything ; pan2026eip ) . In a simulated office workload, spreadsheets from different company regions vary in language and content but share similar calculations. Codex creates batch-lookup and summarization tools: first-task tool calls fall from 13 to 3, while wall time rises by 54.9% and tokens by 15.7%. A separately reported cumulative series shows savings from the second task, reaching 110,351 tokens and 22.97 s after five tasks (Table 3 ). The first-task totals imply increases of 6,453 tokens and 8.51 s, whereas cumulative row 1 reports 4,895 tokens and 6.74 s. This unresolved difference prevents treating the two reports as a single cost trajectory; negative cumulative differences indicate savings.
blocks.zh: 使用 DSH 软件 一切,一个 Codex 插件允许代理在执行过程中生成工具,并保留它们用于以后的任务(shen2026dsheverything ; pan2026eip ). 在模拟办公工作量中,来自不同公司区域的电子表格在语言和内容上各不相同,但也有类似的计算。 Codex创建批量查询和总结工具:第一任务工具调用从13个降至3个,而墙上时间则上升54.9%,信使则上升15.7%. 单独报告的累计系列显示,从第二项任务中节省了费用,达到110 351个令牌,5项任务之后达到22.97个(表3)。 第一任务总数意味着增加6 453个令牌和8.51个s,而累计第1行报告4 895个令牌和6.74个s。 由于这一未解决的差异,无法将两份报告视为单一的费用轨迹;负的累积差异表明有节余。
